headline: Safaricom Acts to Refund Idle M-Pesa Accounts Ahead of State Deadline
summary: Safaricom is refunding M-Pesa accounts idle for 90 days ahead of a November 1 regulatory deadline to transfer funds unclaimed for two years to a state agency.
why: Safaricom is East Africa's most valuable company; its M-Pesa mobile money service handles a substantial portion of Kenya's gross domestic product.

impacts.name: Safaricom PLC
impacts.why: Compliance with unclaimed-asset transfer rules ensures statutory adherence with minimal revenue impact.
